learner_operation: Infer h(x) and g(y), separate dy/g(y)=h(x)dx, integrate with an arbitrary constant, then invert to obtain the requested explicit solution or missing expression and distinguish plausible incorrect integrals/forms.

fixed_features.feature: Elementary first-order separable ODEs and explicit general solutions
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 6767 explicitly separates dy/g(y)=h(x)dx; canonical e-10833 then integrates and solves for y.

fixed_features.feature: A single radio selection from five options or a missing expression in an explicit solution scaffold
fixed_features.justification: The fifteen captured source exercises use these two response forms. q-128198 must not disappear because the old snapshot had fourteen exercises.
Division by g(y) requires g(y) nonzero. Real root branches must be valid, but necessary assumptions do not justify printing the integrated answer in the question.

coverage.case: Independent easy sign/boundary grid and natural sampler control
coverage.result: 48/48 easy parameter cases generated; 43 survive inventory dedup. Sixteen fresh ordinary seeds produce both easy templates and signs; thirteen survive. Fixed-seed grid permutation is an audit control, not evidence of an inherent positional shortcut.

All five survive; all are easy_linear, three positive a and two negative a. No interval leak in this batch. This narrow five-item pool does not represent the missing blank family or the affected moderate families.
Fourteen full banks and correct designations replay; the fifteenth source q-128198 fails. Two normal coefficient settings per supported observed family were inspected.

shortcut_probes.strategy: Square the interval expression, ignoring the ODE.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Four of four versus 1/5 uniformly guessing among five options. The prompt supplies the x-antiderivative; this bypasses the intended integration, rather than expressing a useful simplification of it. All four also survive delivery. q-79665 and q-8304 reveal the complete correct inner expression.

stages_examined: generator parameter validation and absence of rejection/resampling for easy grid
learner select() weighted-band/uniform-member logic; illustrative fresh-history scenarios
delivery.result: Captured inventory basis 5369. Batch 5->5, grid 48->43, fresh seeds 16->13, moderate regression/leak input 28->22, hard 12->11. Interval shortcut remains perfect conditionally in affected survivors. Fresh-learner selection reproduction reaches affected moderate templates; weights/history can remove members but cannot cure their cue. No live policy/history was supplied, so exact future learner frequencies are not asserted.

limitations: No exhaustive audit of every coefficient at moderate/hard; tested source defaults, upper boundaries and targeted leak values.
No finite audit rules out all shortcuts.
The controlled grid deliberately holds the shuffle seed fixed; its all-fifth-position pattern is not an inherent generator finding. Ordinary-seed and exact-batch probes are reported separately.
Live inventory, numeric entity ordering, policy weights and learner histories may differ from captured assumptions. Selection code was examined; exact live selection was not available.
Affected inventory absence is verified for the six captured generated records only, which were reproduced completely; original source questions remain original.
